description: This Java class provides utility methods for tokenizing strings using AES encryption. It initializes an encryption key and offers a method to encrypt a given string, returning the encrypted data as a string.

classes.name: TokenizeTool
classes.description: A utility class for encrypting strings (tokenization) using AES encryption.

methods.name: tokenizeString
methods.description: Encrypts the input string using AES encryption with ECB mode and PKCS5 padding, returning the ciphertext as a string.
